paragraphs.text: Niharet is a Human follower of the Chitin Court from Amonkhet .
Niharet has long, curly hair and usually carries a khopesh .

Niharet and her partner, Mahitab , were the last surviving crop -mates of Basri Ket . She was once opinionated, self-possessed, and clever. After she spoke out of turn too many times and spoke of gods that were meant to be forgotten, she was branded a dissenter and sealed in a sarcophagus. Mahitab freed her during the Hour of Devastation , but she was changed, losing much of her personality and gaining claustrophobia and persistent night terrors.

Disillusioned with the primary Amonkheti pantheon, she became a follower of the Chitin Court . After the War of the Spark , she and Mahitab were among the crew who entombed Temmet . Four years later, they returned to the tomb with Basri, Marunaten, and Merinaten to disentomb the former vizier. After Niharet revealed her allegiance to the Chitin Court and the Monarchs , the two split.
